            ("x2", "x5"): -1,
            ("x4", "x7"): -1,
            ("x5", "x8"): -1,
        },
        "constant": -35,  # Known optimal value
    }

    qp = QuadraticProgram(name="CFD_HPC")

    # Add variables
    for i in range(1, 10):
        qp.binary_var(f"x{i}")

    # Add objective function
    qp.minimize(linear=qubo_dict["linear"])

    # Add constraints
    for constraint in constraints:
        if constraint["type"] == "budget_inequality":
            qp.linear_constraint(
                linear=constraint["expression"], sense="<=", rhs=constraint["budget_limit"]

            qp.linear_constraint(
                linear={f"x{constraint['expression']}[1]": 1, f"x{constraint['expression'][1]}": -1},
                sense="==",
                rhs=0,
